verdict.rationale: The story applies to a browser and fetch platform, but nothing in the evidence documents passing user-supplied session cookies to the fetch API or to sessions. The closest items are marketing claims that agents log in and get past login walls, which is a different mechanism (the agent authenticating itself), and network interception, which is only a developer building block. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication
